0022600209.text: The Phoenix Suns (3-5, 3-2 at home, 12th in the West) host the San Antonio Spurs (8-2, 1st in the Southwest), who have won eight straight, while the Suns have won their last two games. Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on March 19, 2026 in San Antonio, where the Suns lost 101-100.
